1	// Room "P3 upper hall" (interior designer's part): the gambrel landing at the stair top. Box x55..57, y6..8, z14..20.
2	// The stair (x55, z15..18) and the doorway first cells (57,6,15), (57,6,19) and the window cells (55,14), (57,14) stay
3	// clear. Focal piece: a spruce coat rack on the north wall between the two windows, where the stair top looks.
4	// Supporting pieces: a fence-and-slab table with a candle in the south-west corner, a linen chest and a barrel dresser
5	// in the south-east, a stair bench on the west wall, a carpet runner up the lane. One standing lantern on the barrel
6	// lights the whole landing (no ceiling block is assumed above it).
7	import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
8	
9	export function build(g) {
10	  // the focal piece: a hall stand on the north row, between the windows (x56, z14): a spruce fence post with a potted
11	  // plant on top. The palette has no banner, so the coat rack's cloth is left out.
12	  g.set(56, 6, 14, "spruce_fence");
13	  g.set(56, 7, 14, "potted_poppy");
14	
15	  // furniture and lamps by layer. Rows run along +x (55..57), successive rows along +z (14..20). Spaces are left as found.
16	  layers(g, [55, 6, 14], {
17	    "r": "brown_carpet",                                    // runner up the middle lane
18	    "b": ["barrel", { facing: "up", open: "false" }],        // dresser in the south-east corner, lamp on its top
19	    "k": ["oak_stairs", { facing: "west", half: "bottom", shape: "straight" }], // bench, back to the west wall
20	    "T": "oak_fence",                                       // table leg
21	    "C": ["chest", { facing: "north", type: "single" }],    // linen chest by the table
22	  }, [
23	    [
24	      "...",   // z14: window cells x55 and x57 stay clear, coat rack (above) at x56
25	      " r.",   // z15: stair x55; doorway first cell x57 clear
26	      " r.",   // z16
27	      " r.",   // z17
28	      "..b",   // z18: stair top landing (x55) clear; barrel dresser at x57
29	      "k..",   // z19: bench on x55; doorway first cell x57 clear
30	      ".TC",   // z20: table x56, chest x57
31	    ],
32	  ]);
33	
34	  // the lamp on the barrel, and the table top (a top slab on the fence) with a candle; placed above the layer above
35	  layers(g, [55, 7, 14], {
36	    "L": ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }],                 // standing on the barrel top
37	    "S": ["oak_slab", { type: "top" }],                     // table top, sits on the fence post
38	  }, [
39	    [
40	      "...",
41	      "...",
42	      "...",
43	      "...",
44	      "..L",   // z18: lantern on the barrel at (57,7,18)
45	      "...",
46	      ".S.",   // z20: table top at (56,7,20)
47	    ],
48	  ]);
49	
50	  // a lit candle on the table top, the second light in the south-west
51	  layers(g, [55, 8, 14], {
52	    "c": ["candle", { candles: "2", lit: "true" }],
53	  }, [
54	    [
55	      "...",
56	      "...",
57	      "...",
58	      "...",
59	      "...",
60	      "...",
61	      ".c.",   // z20: candle on the table top at (56,8,20)
62	    ],
63	  ]);
64	}

input.summary:
parts/room-26.mjs ("room: P3 upper hall") now places 10 blocks with 0 refused and 0 off-palette; make.sh produced build.nbt.
The five refused writes sat on the z14 and z20 rows at y6–7, which the shell and roof already fill. The hall stand, table and chest moved into the east column (x57, z16–17), clear of the doorway cells at z15 and z19.
The north-wall focal piece is dropped; nothing in the locked row is free to hold it.
left: Focal piece dropped: the north row (x56, z14, y6..7) is occupied by earlier parts, so the spruce hall stand has no place on the north wall. Restoring it needs the shell or roof owner to free that cell.

Table, chest and candle moved from the south row to the east column (x57, z16..17). Their walkable clearance has not been checked with mcd walk or mcd room; the doorway at (57,6,19) may now only be reached through the lane.
Chest facing changed from north to west so it faces into the hall from the east wall.

waste.what: Worked out by hand which cells in the x55..57, z14..20 box the earlier parts already filled, then moved each refused piece to a free cell.
waste.cost: One full make.sh run to see the five refusals, then a second run to confirm; about 4 coordinate sets re-derived by hand.
waste.tool: A `mcd plan build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "P3 upper hall"` before writing (its 'o' cells already there) or a runParts dry-run that lists refused cells per part; a layers() option that skips occupied cells and reports them would have avoided the second pass.

waste.what: Chose a new furniture position by reasoning about walking lanes without checking them.
waste.cost: No walk check run; the doorway-reachability question is left open.
waste.tool: `mcd room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "P3 upper hall"` after each rebuild to confirm walkability and light.

companions.task: Check the table and chest against the locked north and south rows, and decide whether the hall stand fits anywhere else in the landing.
Confirm the barrel lantern and the table candle leave the landing with no dark cell at the feet.
